    About this item

    • feela 8 Pack Soft Cover Journals include 8 pastel colors A5 college ruled soft cover travel journals. 250 GSM colored paper cover outside and 80 GSM smooth writing lined pages inside.
    • These travel journals bulk for women have 92 blank lined pages (46 sheets), which would be sufficient for daily usage. The note taking notebooks have a smooth cover, round corners and tight stitching, which are designed to lay 180° flat. Some quick notes can help you remember important dates and find the page you want in a very short time.
    • Use it as a travel journal. Travelers can use it as travel journal to write down precious moments and thoughts. Each measures 8.2” x 5.5”, which is convenient to carry in hand or just put it in the bag.
    • Use it as a notebook for school supplies and business notebook for work. Teachers can hand out these notebooks to students. Students of primary school and college can use it to write down notes or hand in homework. Commuters can use it to arrange your daily work schedule and jot down important milestones.
    • Performance& Satisfaction: We provide you with not only our high quality products but also our quick response service.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

      Feela Soft Cover Journals - A Bulk Buy Delight!
      Reviewed in the United States on January 7, 2024
      Color: 8 Navy
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I am delighted with the 8 Pack Soft Cover Journal Bulk from Feela. As someone who loves jotting down thoughts, notes, and ideas, this set of notebooks is a dream come true.

      The college-ruled pages provide the perfect balance between spaciousness and structure, making these notebooks ideal for both work and personal use. The soft cover adds a touch of elegance while ensuring flexibility and durability, making them perfect for on-the-go journaling.

      The bulk buy option is a fantastic value for money, ensuring I have a reliable stash of high-quality notebooks for an extended period. The compact size makes them travel-friendly, fitting seamlessly into my bag or backpack.

      Whether I'm in a meeting or capturing moments during my travels, the Feela Soft Cover Journals have become my go-to companions. The quality of the paper is excellent, providing a smooth writing experience with minimal bleed-through.

      For anyone in need of reliable, versatile, and aesthetically pleasing notebooks, the 8 Pack Soft Cover Journal Bulk from Feela is an absolute winner. A solid 5-star rating for a product that combines functionality with affordability. Highly recommended!

      I have the Lochby Field Journal and like to have different journal books for different subjects and these fill the bill. They fit perfectly in my Lochby. The paper is decent but does bleed a little depending on the pen and ink used, not a big deal though. Each book has a decent amount of pages. I cannot speak to the durability of these as I have not had them long enough, though I will say the front and back covers are fine with a journal cover like the Lochby or other but not sure how they would hold up on their own.

      A small grip with these is that the manufacturer waists the first page by lashings logo on it. (Very small grip)

      This is a good affordable soft cover A5 journal. I use it with a fountain pen and the paper hold up well without ink bleeding trough. I use a fine or extra fine nib with this paper so I can write small, but if you use a medium or broad nib or any other pen that uses a large volume of ink, then you might get some bleeding or ghosting, but generally its very good quality.

      Exactly what I wanted and my new favorite journal. I am left-handed and the way this journal opens up flat works well for me. The paper also takes ink really well; with other journals I have tried, the paper did not take the ink well enough, and my hand would smudge through the ink before it had a chance to dry. I love that it is lightweight and fits perfectly in my bag or even my purse. I love the number of pages, not too few --or too many; it's perfect for the kind of work I do, makes it easier to find my notes later on. I love that I can just throw my favorite vinyl sticker on the front cover, to tell them apart, but they all line up neatly, same size and color, on a shelf. I added a blue bee sticker to the one I'm currently using. Please keep making this product!

      I have tried to share photos but Amazon doesn't seem to want to let me do that, today. Will try again later.

    About this Item

    • feela 8 Pack Soft Cover Journals include 8 pastel colors A5 college ruled soft cover travel journals. 250 GSM colored paper cover outside and 80 GSM smooth writing lined pages inside.
    • These travel journals bulk for women have 92 blank lined pages (46 sheets), which would be sufficient for daily usage. The note taking notebooks have a smooth cover, round corners and tight stitching, which are designed to lay 180° flat. Some quick notes can help you remember important dates and find the page you want in a very short time.
    • Use it as a travel journal. Travelers can use it as travel journal to write down precious moments and thoughts. Each measures 8.2” x 5.5”, which is convenient to carry in hand or just put it in the bag.
    • Use it as a notebook for school supplies and business notebook for work. Teachers can hand out these notebooks to students. Students of primary school and college can use it to write down notes or hand in homework. Commuters can use it to arrange your daily work schedule and jot down important milestones.
